Reference: 6002R-001 Year: NA Material: Rose Gold Case Diameter: 44 Dial: Brown Glass: Sapphire Condition: Unworn Comes with Original Box And Original Papers Patek Philippe gives the Reference 6002 Sky Moon Tourbillon a new look by combining the warm glow of rose gold with a Grand Feu brown enamel decoration. The double-faced case, crowns, slide piece, hour/minute hands and fold-over clasp are entirely hand-engraved with volutes and arabesques. The front dial combines Grand Feu champlevé and cloisonné enameling. This exceptional timepiece, the second most complicated Patek Philippe wristwatch (12 complications). Mechanical manually wound movement. Caliber R TO 27 QR SID LU CL. Sky Moon Tourbillon. Double-faced wristwatch. Minute repeater with “cathedral” gongs. Tourbillon. Front side: Perpetual calendar with retrograde date hand. Day, month, leap year in apertures. Hours and minutes of mean solar time. Moon phases. Reverse side: sidereal time, sky chart, phases and orbit of the moon. Grand Feu champlevé and cloisonné brown enamel, gold applied Roman numerals. 18K gold dial plate. Rose gold. Sapphire-crystal case back. Humidity- and dust-protected only (not water-resistant). Case diameter: 44. Height: 17.35. Alligator leather with square scales, hand-stitched, chestnut patinated. Hand-engraved fold-over clasp.
